id: title:Gilbert09:query hogpanion via sudo in the golden smoke test

review.posthog_relevance: Changes to the golden-image provisioning and smoke testing scripts, not PostHog application code.
review.reason: The observed changes are strictly limited to shell scripts used for infrastructure provisioning and automated testing of the 'hogpanion' service. P1.F1.H1 removes a diagnostic logging command, while P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 update systemctl and journalctl commands to use sudo, correcting the inspection of the hogpanion service state and environment. These changes do not modify PostHog
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned because the changes are substantive and bounded, improving the reliability of the provisioning test, but they do not affect PostHog application behavior, query results, or user-facing features. No tier 2 or 3 is applicable as no application-layer changes are present.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains changes to shell scripts used for automated testing and provisioning of PostHog infrastructure, not PostHog application code. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Removes a diagnostic command that recorded hogpanion service state without sudo, and its associated logging. P1.F1.H1.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes a temporary diagnostic step from the golden-image bake process; does not change PostHog application behavior.

observations.behavior: Changes systemctl and journalctl commands to use sudo, and adds a comment explaining that the box lacks a system D-Bus daemon, requiring root access. P1.F2.H1.
observations.code_quote: pid=$(sudo systemctl show hogpanion.service -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the smoke test for the golden image to correctly query the hogpanion service, which requires root privileges, preventing false negatives in the provisioning test.

observations.behavior: Adds sudo to the systemctl show command used to inspect daemon environment. P1.F2.H2.
observations.code_quote: sudo systemctl show hogpanion.service -p Environment -p EnvironmentFiles --no-pager >&2'
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the smoke test to correctly inspect the hogpanion service environment, which requires root privileges, preventing false negatives in the provisioning test.
